g.title: Possible parent. Meaning: P is a block before the first slot w of the new leader window. Some required certificate evidence can be missing. Purpose: The validator keeps partial evidence and checks again as certificates arrive.
g.text: Consider parent P for window w

g.title: Check parent support. Meaning: P needs an ordinary notar certificate or a notar-fallback certificate. A stronger proof also meets this requirement. Purpose: The new leader needs sufficient stake support for the history it extends. P does not need to be final.
g.text: Does P have a notar certificate

g.title: P01: Parent proof arrives. When: New certificate evidence for P arrives. Action: Check whether the certificate is sufficient for a parent. Reason: A leader needs group support for the parent before normal block production can start.

a.xlink:title: A leader needs group support for the parent before normal block production can start.
P01: Parent proof arrives

g.title: Check the intervening slots. Meaning: Each slot strictly after P and strictly before w needs a skip certificate. Purpose: These certificates permit the new chain to pass those slots. If P is at w minus one, the gap is empty.
g.text: Does every slot j between P and w

g.title: P05: A skip proof arrives. When: A new skip certificate arrives. The parent already has sufficient evidence. Action: Check the gap again. Reason: Certificates can arrive in either order. The new certificate can complete the required evidence.

a.xlink:title: Certificates can arrive in either order. The new certificate can complete the required evidence.
P05: A skip proof arrives

g.title: P03: Parent proof absent. When: The validator lacks sufficient certificate evidence for P. Action: Keep the current evidence and wait. Reason: The validator cannot yet declare P to be a permitted parent.

a.xlink:title: The validator cannot yet declare P to be a permitted parent.
P03: Parent proof absent

g.title: P02: Parent proof sufficient. When: P has a notar or notar-fallback certificate, or a stronger proof. Action: Check each intervening slot. Reason: Support for P alone does not permit the leader to pass unsupported slots.

a.xlink:title: Support for P alone does not permit the leader to pass unsupported slots.
P02: Parent proof\nsufficient

g.title: P04: A skip proof is absent. When: At least one intervening slot lacks a skip certificate. Action: Wait for the missing certificate. Reason: The leader needs permission to pass every slot in the gap.

a.xlink:title: The leader needs permission to pass every slot in the gap.
P04: A skip proof is absent
a.text: P04: A skip proof is absent

g.title: ParentReady. Meaning: The parent proof and every required skip proof are available. P is a parent that window w can use. Purpose: This permits pending vote checks, starts window timers, and lets the scheduled leader proceed. More than one parent can be ready.

P06: All required proofs exist. When: Every intervening slot has a skip certificate. This condition also holds when there are no intervening slots. Action: Record ParentReady(w,P). Reason: The leader can now connect a new block to P with the required certificate evidence.

a.xlink:title: The leader can now connect a new block to P with the required certificate evidence.
P06: All required proofs\nexist

g.title: Check pending blocks again. Meaning: The validator checks stored blocks whose parent condition can now pass. Purpose: It can vote for a block it already has, without waiting for the block to arrive again.
g.text: Their parent condition can now pass

g.title: P07: Retry pending votes. When: The validator records a new ready parent. Action: Check stored blocks again in slot order. Reason: A stored block can now meet the parent condition that earlier prevented its initial notar vote.

a.xlink:title: A stored block can now meet the parent condition that earlier prevented its initial notar vote.
P07: Retry pending votes

g.title: Start window timers. Meaning: The first ParentReady event starts the timers for the window. More ready parents do not restart them. Purpose: The deadlines limit the wait for leader progress. Repeated certificates must not postpone that wait indefinitely.
g.text: Start timers once for window w
Later ready parents do not restart them

g.title: P08: Start timers once. When: This is the first ParentReady event for window w. Action: Start the window timers. Keep existing timers when more parents become ready. Reason: The validator now has a reference time for leader progress. Later certificates must not postpone the deadlines indefinitely.

a.xlink:title: The validator now has a reference time for leader progress. Later certificates must not postpone the deadlines indefinitely.
P08: Start timers once

g.title: Prepare the parent’s local state. Meaning: Agave requests a replay-bank switch when the ready parent is above the local root. Purpose: The validator needs that parent’s execution state before it can execute a child block.
g.text: Agave: request replay of parent P
when P is above the local root

g.title: P09: Prepare local parent state. When: Agave receives a ready parent above the local root. Action: Request the required replay-bank switch. Reason: The validator needs the parent’s execution state to process blocks that extend that parent.

a.xlink:title: The validator needs the parent's execution state to process blocks that extend that parent.
P09: Prepare local parent\nstate

g.title: Start this leader’s work. Meaning: If this validator leads the window, Agave selects a ready parent and requests block production. Purpose: The leader now has the parent evidence for its first block. Agave does not start a window that has already passed.
g.text: If this validator is the leader:

g.title: P10: Start scheduled leader work. When: This validator leads the ready window, and Agave has not already passed that window. Action: Select a permitted parent. Send ProduceWindow to block creation. Reason: The leader can produce a connected block now that the required evidence exists.

a.xlink:title: The leader can produce a connected block now that the required evidence exists.
P10: Start scheduled leader\nwork
